description: This PHP source file defines the ValidationUniqueAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for validating the uniqueness of certain entity attributes within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for handling GET requests to check if a value is unique for specified entities, with validation rules and entity-specific attribute configurations.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for validating the uniqueness of entity attribute values in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to check if a given value is unique for a specified entity and attribute.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method parameters.

methods.name: getAttributeNameRuleArray
methods.description: Returns attribute name options based on the entity name.

methods.name: getMatchByFieldRuleArray
methods.description: Returns match-by field options based on the entity name.
